title: Configuration adjacency formula
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $n,s$, define the adjacency CNF formula to be the concatenation of the input-equality formula and the transition formula for these parameters.
caveat: The input-equality formula is referenced but its construction is not included in the supplied material.
